title: HMRC sends 81,000 warning letters to crypto holders in tax campaign
seoTitle: HMRC Sends 81,000 Warning Letters to Crypto Holders
subtitle: Number of notifications nearly triples since 2024, Freedom of Information request reveals
excerpt: UK tax authority HMRC has sent 81,000 warning letters to crypto asset holders, a number that has nearly tripled compared to 2024.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The UK tax authority (HMRC) has sent 81,000 warning letters to individuals holding crypto assets as part of its campaign to combat tax evasion. The volume of notifications indicates a significant increase in enforcement within this sector.

Scale of the operation

According to a Freedom of Information (FOI) request, the number of letters sent has nearly tripled since 2024, demonstrating HMRC's intensified efforts in monitoring transactions involving digital currencies.

Purpose of the letters

The communications serve to alert crypto asset holders of the obligation to declare gains and losses on their income tax, reinforcing the need to comply with current tax regulations.

With information from BBC News.
